title: Multidimensional proteomics and explainable AI feature selection identify cross-platform lung cancer molecular signature in blood plasma
summary: Explainable-AI feature selection across mass-spectrometry and proximity-extension proteomics identifies a cross-platform blood-plasma lung-cancer molecular signature.
ai_technology: Measured plasma from 490 treatment-naive lung-cancer cases and 124 controls is analyzed with independent platforms and cohort comparisons.
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: Signature performance and stage coverage are promising but do not establish prospective screening benefit.
evidence.unknown: The reviewed source does not establish prospective benefit, broad external validity, or replication beyond the reported study.
evidence.ai_role: Measured plasma from 490 treatment-naive lung-cancer cases and 124 controls is analyzed with independent platforms and cohort comparisons.
